actions.name: curve forward, left wheel 40 %, right wheel 20 % (turns right)
curve forward, left wheel 10 %, right wheel 40 % (turns left)
curve forward, left wheel 40 %, right wheel 10 % (turns right)

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, curve forward at 40 % / 20 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is less than 3 cm ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve forward at 10 % / 40 %; else curve forward at 40 % / 10 %.
The motor blocks run without end, so the program never stops by itself.

likely_intent.description: Get the robot through the tunnel, out at its other end.

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads less than 70 %

uncertainties: In the dark your program curves right (40 % left, 20 % right), so in a straight tunnel it turns into the wall and does not get through.
